summary: A note from Alex McKenzie at BBN with network traffic statistics for July 1972. BBN had given ARPA a monthly summary of host packets output and, after requests, agreed to publish them as RFCs. The figures are monthly totals or overall averages. It was replaced by RFC 391.

eli5.summary: This is a monthly tally from the early internet, showing how many packets each computer sent. Think of counting how many letters each house mailed in a month, so the post office can see where the traffic is.

questions: how much traffic did each arpanet host send
